sourceAuthority.title: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sourceAuthority.contract: The object frame is version-aware; common-tail owner and reactor handles are soft pointers, and extension-dictionary handles are hard owners.

scope: Generated regression matrix for the shared R13/R14/R2000 object-frame and common-tail observer used by the bounded dictionary and MLINESTYLE source checks. No production parser layout or support profile changed.

controls.frame: Retains version-dependent object-size location, valid body boundary, wrong-version and out-of-frame size refusal, every byte truncation, and successful valid-frame recheck after refusal.
controls.handleRoles: At each owner, reactor, and typed-null extension-dictionary position, tries all 16 role nibbles; accepts only role 4, 4, and 3 respectively. Also mutates each non-null target and requires refusal followed by valid-frame acceptance. On both hash-bound paired AC1012 dictionary frames, independently walks common-tail links and every item handle, mutates each role to an invalid role, verifies observer/parser refusal and reset, then retries the original frame successfully. The source common tail retains valid ODA soft-pointer offset encodings while mutations are rejected.
controls.specGeneratedAc1012Dictionary: The self-contained CTest assembles an in-memory AC1012 DICTIONARY object frame in ODA §20.4.44 order: object size, reactor count, two TV/item pairs, relative soft-pointer parent, soft-pointer reactor, typed-null hard-owner extension dictionary, and soft-owner item handles. The typed parser and shared observer accept it; invalid common/item roles and every byte truncation refuse, reset, and accept a corrected retry. This is a generated object-frame control, not a complete DWG file or producer/native evidence.
controls.testLabels: The focused CTest labels now identify AC1012, AC1014, and AC1015 coverage.
